lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank, with primary local maxima forming roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot patterns at near-right angles, creating anchor nodes where high-luminance blobs are centered within the grid cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient (light upper, shadowed lower) runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered near the basal and mid-sections of the fin's lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive tissue loss on the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin, resulting in a jagged, multi-notched profile instead of a continuous anatomical curve.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral-lateral region just posterior to the insertion point of the left pectoral fin.
